name: Bugsink
description: Bugsink is a self-hosted error tracker that accepts events from the official Sentry SDKs, so existing apps only need a new DSN. It groups exceptions into issues with full stack traces, source context, releases and tags, and sends alerts by email or webhook, while staying light enough for a single small server.

notes.text: Sign in at http://<IP>:8000 with the email and password from /opt/bugsink_data/.env.
DSNs and allowed hosts come from BASE_URL in /opt/bugsink_data/bugsink_conf.py, set to the container IP. Change it and restart bugsink when the IP changes or Bugsink moves behind a domain.
